info.name: Validate a member map's unmapped dimension members by ID

params.name: objectId
params.description: The ID of the analytic object.

params.name: dimensionId
params.description: The ID of a dimension of the member map.

items.docs:
If you know the ID of a member map, use this API to validate one of the member map's dimensions. 
 You must also know the dimension's ID and the analytic object's ID. 
 The response returns the member map ID, the requested dimension ID, a list of the dimension's unmapped members, and a list of errors found.

info.name: Retrieve a list of dimension members

params.name: objectId
params.description: The ID of the analytic object.

params.name: dimensionId
params.description: The ID of the dimension.

params.name: id
params.description: The IDs of the members to retrieve. Default is all members.

params.name: maxLevel
params.description: The maximum level in the hierarchy to fetch. The top level of the hierarchy is 0. Default is all levels.

params.name: filter
params.description: A regular expression that members must match to be retrieved. Default is to retrieve all members.

params.name: field
params.description:
Indicates the aspect of the member to apply the filter to. Possible values are:
 - **id**: Match the filter to the member ID.
 - **display**: Match the filter to the member's display name.
 - **either**: Match the filter to the member ID or display name.

 Default is `id`.

params.name: includeDataMembers
params.description: Indicates whether data members are included in the response. Parent-child dimensions only. Default is `false`.

params.name: offset
params.description: For paginated member requests against high-cardinality dimensions, the offset of the first member to retrieve. Default is 0. If the `offset` value is specified to a non-default value, all other non-pagination parameters are ignored.

params.name: limit
params.description: For paginated member requests against high-cardinality dimensions, the maximum number of members to retrieve. Default is -1 to return up to 15,000 members. If the `limit` value is specified to a non-default value, all other non-pagination parameters are ignored. If pagination occurs, the response status code is 206.

params.name: sortType
params.description:
The order of the members in the response. Valid values:
 - `configured`: Sorts the members according to their configuration. For parent-child dimensions, sorts members by name in ascending order. For other dimensions, sorts members by their configured order in Studio.
 - `natural`: Does not sort the members. This is the default.

items.docs:

params.name: displayName
params.description: Returns plans that match the specified display name. Ignores text case and includes partial matches. For example, `displayName=WFP Plan` returns plans named "WFP Plan 2024", "WFP plan v1", and "WFP plan - Product".

params.name: model
params.description: Returns plans that belong to the specified planning model ID.

params.name: planStatus
params.description:
Returns plans with the specified plan status. Valid values:
 - **ASSIGNED**: The subplan has been assigned to a subplanner.
 - **IN_PROGRESS**: The subplanner has opened the subplan.
 - **OVERDUE**: The subplan was not completed on time.
 - **SUBMITTED**: The subplan has been submitted for review.
 - **SENT_BACK**: The subplan was rejected and returned to the subplanner for editing.
 - **CONSOLIDATED**: The subplan has been accepted and combined into the primary plan.

params.name: createdStart
params.description: Returns plans created on or after this date. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: createdEnd
params.description: Return plans created on or before this date. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: editedStart
params.description: Returns plans edited on or after this date. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: editedEnd
params.description: Returns plans edited on or before this date. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
Orders plan results by the specified value. Valid values:
 - **LAST_EDITED_DATE**: Orders plans by the last edited date. This is the default.
 - **CREATED_DATE**: Orders plans by the creation date.
 - **PLAN_MODEL**: Orders plans alphabetically by planning model.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sorts plan results by the specified value. Valid values are `ASCENDING` or `DESCENDING`. Default is `DESCENDING`.

params.name: excludeSubplans
params.description: If `true`, the response doesn't return subplans. Default is `true`.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Sets the maximum number of results to return per page. Default is 50.

params.name: page
params.description: Sets the results page to return. If undefined, returns the first 50 results. To get the next 50 results, specify `page=2`.
